name: Robust functional mixed model (R-FMM), wavelet implementation R-WFMM
model_likelihood: D = X B* + Z U* + E*; coefficientwise conditionally Gaussian random effects and residuals with individual random variances
prior: Spike-Gaussian fixed effects conditional on variances; exponential variance mixing; Gamma squared population scales with vague empirical Bayes hyperpriors
inference_algorithm: Blocked Gibbs sampling in wavelet space; inverse DWT of posterior function samples
estimand: Posterior distributions of fixed and random effect functions in data space
data_input: Curves on a common equally spaced grid; fixed-effect design X; random-effect design Z
tunable_settings: Wavelet transform/basis; mixing-distribution family; top-level Gamma and Beta hyperprior specification (empirical Bayes defaults); burn-in and retained posterior sample count
